note: Inbound prompt screening and outbound tool-execution blocking are separate host capabilities. A host that intercepts a prompt does not necessarily allow refusing it, and a host that can refuse a tool call does not necessarily expose the prompt. Each field below records what the named host version can do, not what Little Canary wishes it could do.

hosts.name: Claude Code

inbound.interception_point: after the prompt is submitted, before the turn starts
inbound.runtime_evidence: Verified against Claude Code 2.1.261 for release 0.3.7; see README 'Claude Code plugin'. Not re-exercised at runtime by this certification.

caveats: Screens the submitted prompt only. Tool results, tool arguments, and file contents read during the turn are never screened.
A request body over 64 KiB is rejected by the loopback server with HTTP 413 and is therefore not screened at all.

hosts.name: Codex CLI

inbound.interception_point: after the prompt is submitted, before the turn starts
inbound.runtime_evidence: Install route exercised: `codex plugin marketplace add <checkout>` then `codex plugin add little-canary@hermes-labs` reports `installed, enabled` at 0.3.8 and copies hooks/hooks.json plus the adapter into the plugin cache. Interception itself was NOT observed: in a headless `codex exec` run against an isolated CODEX_HOME the hook did not execute, no hook-trust state was recorded, and the prompt proceeded to the model call with no warning. Codex gates hook execution behind an explicit trust approval that a non-interactive run cannot give.

caveats: Codex does not run a hook until its source is trusted. Until a maintainer approves the hook interactively, the plugin is installed and enabled but screens nothing, and Codex says nothing about it.
The same limits as the Claude Code route apply: submitted prompt only, 64 KiB body ceiling.

hosts.name: Gemini CLI

inbound.runtime_evidence: Verified against Gemini CLI 0.32.1 for release 0.3.7; see README 'Gemini CLI extension'. Not re-exercised at runtime by this certification.

caveats: Denies one agent run at its pre-agent boundary. Tool calls made inside an allowed run are not screened.

hosts.name: OpenAI Agents SDK

inbound.runtime_evidence: Offline tests exercised against openai-agents 0.22.0; the SDK tripwire is the deny channel. No live model call is involved in the guardrail decision.

caveats: Only user-message text is screened. Tool outputs and non-text content are outside this adapter.
SDK input guardrails run only for the first agent in a chain.

hosts.name: Hermes Agent

inbound.interception_point: before the model call, context injection only
inbound.runtime_evidence: Verified against hermes-agent 0.19.0 for release 0.3.7. pre_llm_call is a context-injection hook with no deny channel: a blocked turn still reaches the model, annotated.

caveats: This is the one host where Little Canary blocks outbound tool execution rather than inbound prompt delivery.
A BLOCK verdict withdraws the turn's tool authority. It does not stop the prompt from reaching the model.

hosts.name: GitHub Copilot CLI

inbound.interception_point: after the user submits a prompt
inbound.runtime_evidence: Artifact-certified, not runtime-certified. UserPromptSubmittedHookOutput exposes modifiedPrompt, additionalContext, and suppressOutput and no decision field; only PreToolUseHookOutput carries permissionDecision allow/deny/ask. See docs/host-evidence/copilot-cli-1.0.84-5-hook-outputs.d.ts. The Copilot CLI was not installed on this machine, so no run was exercised.

caveats: Copilot cannot refuse an inbound prompt at any hook. A userPromptSubmitted hook can rewrite or annotate the prompt; the prompt still reaches the model.

Copilot's file-configured hooks use a different manifest than Claude Code and Codex: `.github/hooks/*.json`, `version: 1`, camelCase event names, and `bash`/`timeoutSec` keys. The `plugins/claude-code` hook manifest is not loadable by Copilot.
Little Canary ships no Copilot artifact. A Copilot marketplace listing of this plugin is an install route for other hosts, not evidence of Copilot prompt screening.
